summary: TRACK 18.00 Phase E — Transportation Operations Portal Transformation: PASS. Backend regression 40/40 PASS (test_track_18_00_phase_e_portal_transformation.py, 0.29s). Live UI validated: dispatcher login at /dispatch-portal/login lands on /dispatch-portal hub; TransportationOpsTopBar mounted with all six required testids (txops-portal-topbar, brand='Transportation Operations', nav, search, mission-control) plus all 5 grouped nav rails (ops/people/compliance/intel/admin) opening with the correct items (Operations: Mission Control/Dispatch/Live Operations/Fleet; People: Drivers/Carriers; Compliance: Compliance/Orientation; Intel: Intelligence/Cleanup/Automation; Admin: Reports/Audit). dispatch-hub testid, DispatchMapHero canvas, and dispatch-mx-indicator banner all render below the TopBar. Phase D right rail preserved live: /admin/transportation/live-operations?entity_type=driver&entity_id=ghost renders txops-workspace-shell + txops-right-rail + all 5 section testids (recent-activity, timeline, related, open-actions, audit). Phase D backend envelope preserved: GET /api/admin/transportation/related/driver/ghost with X-Admin-Token returns schema_version=18.00D, entity.title='(not found)'. Zero JS console errors / pageerrors observed on /dispatch-portal hub, on /admin/transportation index, and on /live-operations.
